'''Elan's dome''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gala]], in the encampment of the [[Hill people]]. It was a white dome constructed out of a flexible material that was bolted to struts. In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], shortly after the [[Battle of Gala|battle]] against the [[Royal guard (Gala)|royal guards]], Elan, leader of the Hill people and also their [[Doctor/Legends|healer]], treated the injuries of her soldiers in her dome.<ref name="MotC">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown]]''</ref>
